data.narrative:
Delian Alliance Industries is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company that has raised $14M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 peers—2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic—spanning Seed through Series A stages.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical for Seed-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $35M. The peer-median method examines 5 same-sector comparables at matching or adjacent stages: Stark Defence ($4.0B Series A), UFORCE ($1.0B Seed), Castelion ($1.0B Series A), Singularity ($400M Series A), and NODA AI ($125M Series A). The median valuation across this set is $1.0B, with a range of $125M to $4.0B, reflecting the wide variance typical of early-stage defense-tech valuations.

The triangulated analysis supports a range of $30M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $518M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty: stage-progression yields near the low end given limited operational data at Seed stage, while peer-median is anchored by UFORCE's $1.0B valuation at an identical stage. Key uncertainties include technology differentiation within the competitive peer set, capital efficiency relative to comparable burn rates, and regulatory/export constraints in the defense sector that may not be fully reflected in public comparables.
